tools.name: retirement_quick_check
tools.description: Will my retirement savings last? Estimates the chance a portfolio lasts through retirement, given savings, yearly spending, years in retirement and the share in bonds, from simulations on global market history (with a US-only comparison). A horizon given as ages works: years = end age minus current

tools.name: run_plan
tools.description: Runs a full Foresight Planner retirement plan for a person or couple living in Canada (outside Quebec) or the US, on the person's Foresight Planner account. It returns the chance the money lasts, from simulations on global market history; income tax in the first retirement year and over the whole pl

tools.name: get_plan_result
tools.description: Gets the result of a Foresight Planner plan that run_plan started but that was still running when run_plan answered. Pass the run_id run_plan gave. Free: it uses no plan run. If the plan is still running, it says so; call it again a little later.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report or feature request to Foresight Planner. Use when the user asks to send feedback, raises a problem with Foresight Planner, when a Foresight Planner tool in this conversation failed or returned something inconsistent, or when the user asked for something Foresight Planner's tools co

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "run_plan" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
